title: WordPress Plugin Factory — Plugin Spec
description: Fully determines a generated WordPress plugin: identity, requirements, selected modules, options and glue-code features.

slug.description: Plugin folder / main file slug. Lowercase kebab-case.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in wp-admin.

description.description: Short plugin tagline used in the plugin header and readme.txt.

namespace.description: Root PHP namespace, PSR-4, e.g. AnsariAi\StoreHealth.

textDomain.description: WordPress i18n text domain. Should equal slug unless there is a reason not to.

version.description: Semantic version of the generated plugin.

requires.description: Minimum runtime requirements, used for plugin headers and requirements() checks.

license.description: Configures the license-client module. Omit or set enabled=false for a free plugin.

server.description: Base URL of the ansariaiwp license API, e.g. https://ansariaiwp.com/api/v1. Never a GitHub URL — private update delivery only.

productId.description: Product identifier known to the license server. Defaults to slug.

modules.description: Module ids (folder names under modules/) to include. Order does not matter; dependencies are resolved automatically.

options.description: Plugin-level Settings API fields the Settings scaffold should render and sanitize.

key.description: Option key suffix, appended to the plugin prefix, e.g. report_email => {prefix}_report_email.

tab.description: Settings tab id this field belongs to. Defaults to 'general'.

features.description: Short natural-language descriptions of custom glue logic an agent should implement in a Glue class. Documentation-only; does not affect tools/compose.php output directly.

glueClass.description: Optional fully-qualified class name (under {{NAMESPACE}}\Glue) providing custom logic beyond modules. See docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md.
